sloka: सालस्य आस्तीर्य सुग्रीवः निषसाद स राघवः ।लक्ष्मनाय अथ संहृष्टो हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः ॥४-५-१९॥
transliteration: sālasya āstīrya sugrīvaḥ niṣasāda sa rāghavaḥ ।lakṣmanāya atha saṁhṛṣṭo hanumān mārutātmajaḥ ॥4-5-19॥

translations.english: Then Sugriva cut the branch of a sala tree with luxuriant leaves and flowers, spread it on the ground and sat down along with Raghava.
